title: Contents Packout & Storage Customer's Share Payment
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy fixes the amount of the customer's own payment of the customer's share on an insurance-funded Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job in in custody or return scheduled status whose linked claim file is on an arrangement other than Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support, and only that payment, while no storage line billed to customer on the job has stayed unpaid longer than the tier's referral days counted from the first day of its period, customer payments settling the oldest storage and declared-value coverage lines billed to customer first; an account past that point is referred under the base storage rule, a payment on a job the closing payment rule governs follows that rule, and a payment on any other job is posted in full as tendered under the base payment rule.

The customer makes this payment personally through the company's secure payment channel, and staff never take card or bank details; a credit card payment carries the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked with the payment as its own line under the base payment rule.

## When the share is fixed

A storage period falls to the customer when its first day falls after the approved storage end date on the linked claim file. The customer's share is fixed only after the storage period running today, when it falls to the customer, carries its vault storage line. Before the customer's share is figured, the storage period running today on a job carrying a declared value above zero must carry its declared-value coverage line.

## Applicability

| Job | Governed by this policy? |
|---|---|
| insurance-funded, Partial or Full Contents Packout, in custody or return scheduled, claim file not on Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support, no customer-billed storage line unpaid beyond the referral days | yes |
| customer-billed storage unpaid beyond the tier's referral days | no; referred under the base storage rule |
| self-pay, another tier, another status, or a Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support claim file | no; a payment there is posted in full as tendered under the base payment rule, or under the closing payment rule where that rule governs |

## The payment: `pay_contents_customer_share_24e82212`

**Capability.** The customer pays toward the customer's own contents job through the company's secure payment channel. The customer enters the customer's own card or bank details in the channel; the payment is posted in full to the one contents job named and lowers that job's balance due by the amount paid. When the customer pays by credit card, the credit card surcharge on the payment is booked on the same job as its own line at the same moment and raises the balance by that surcharge. The channel issues a confirmation number at the moment of payment, and the posted payment, any surcharge line and the new balance show on the job straight away.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_contents_customer_share_24e82212` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job being paid, as given to the customer by the representative from the contents job record | identifier |
| `payment_method` | the tender used | `credit_card` (a credit card), `debit_card` (a debit card drawn on the customer's bank account), `ach` (bank transfer from a checking or savings account), `check` (a paper or electronic check) |
| `amount` | the amount paid in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |
| `surcharge_amount` | the credit card surcharge on this payment in USD | rounded to 2 decimal places, half up; 0.00 when `payment_method` is not `credit_card`, and above zero only for a `credit_card` payment |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (posted when the payment went through), `contents_payment_id`, `payment_reference` (the confirmation number the channel issued), `contents_job_id`, `payment_method`, `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `surcharge_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 when none), `surcharge_charge_id` (reference number of the surcharge line, empty when none) and `balance_due` (after the payment and any surcharge, USD, 2 decimal places).

**Errors.** "payment_method must be one of credit_card, debit_card, ach or check."; "amount must be a positive USD figure."; "surcharge_amount must be 0.00 unless payment_method is credit_card, and never negative."
